world.name: app-discord-com
world.scope: Authenticated client and auth flows — everything served by packages/web/app/globals.css (:root tokens, @theme mapping, @layer components primitives, functional animations). Separate from the landing .ftl world (documented in the repo-root DESIGN.md frontmatter and its section; its sidecar is .impeccable/design.json at the repo root). app/sfu/page.tsx is a deliberate debug-surface exclusion.

background.role: Page and auth ground; darkest step

background-surface.role: Raised rows: composer, hover fills, tile rest fill

background-hover.role: Strongest hover step; active list rows

rail.role: 72px server rail, user panel; input fields on panels (bg-field)

list.role: Channel list, members list, 48px header chrome

foreground-muted.role: Secondary ink: labels, sub-copy, quiet controls

foreground-subtle.role: Tertiary ink: small labels, icons at rest

accent.role: The one action color: buttons, active tile, send, caret, focus

accent-hover.role: Accent hover depth; never at rest

secondary.role: Soft blurple: inline text links and brand accent words

success.role: Online presence, speaking ring, add-tile green

border-hover.role: Hover hairline; auth input resting border

fonts.sans: 'gg sans', var(--font-gg), 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.display: 'gg sans', var(--font-gg), 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.disclosure: 'gg sans' is proprietary; the stack prefers a locally installed copy and ships Noto Sans via next/font as --font-gg. Intentional and disclosed.

radii.standard: 8px (rounded-lg): buttons, inputs, cards, menus, tooltips, composer
radii.pill: 9999px (rounded-full): avatars, status dots, tiles at rest, rail divider

spacing.grid: 8px base: 8px control gaps, 16px panel padding, 12/16px rows
spacing.micro: 2px/4px micro-steps for dense rows (message rows: 2px vertical in 16px gutters)

h1.purpose: Auth page titles: 24px/700, -0.01em. Globals sets all h1-h6 to 700/-0.01em.

ui.purpose: Buttons 15px/600; list rows, member names, menu items 14px.

label.purpose: Uppercase 12px/600-700 section and category headers; auth field labels 14px/600, 0.5px tracking, muted.

micro.purpose: Message timestamps, 10px, revealed on row hover.

shadows.name: menu-shadow
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, context menus, tooltips, message hover toolbar. Floating layers only.

shadows.name: input-focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Auth .input focus ring; a state signal, not depth.

shadows.name: new-message-pulse-ring
shadows.purpose: Animated unread attention cue (2s ease-in-out infinite).

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: The interaction family: color-swap hovers, squircle morph (200ms), drawer translate (200ms).

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: View and message entrances; forwards fill.

motion.name: state-flash
motion.purpose: Edited-message flash, reaction and badge feedback.

motion.name: live-loops
motion.purpose: Loops carry live state only (voice, typing, unread) — no ambient decoration.

motion.name: reduced-motion-gate
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none } on every animation class
motion.purpose: All motion dies for reduced-motion users; new animations must join the kill list.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action color: blurple fill, white 15px/600 label, 8px radius, 44px min-height; deepens to #4752c4 on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5865f2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #5865f2; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #4752c4; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent with a #3f4147 border; 4% white veil and lighter border on hover. The OAuth pair style.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5865f2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #efeff1; border: 1px solid #3f4147; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border-color: #949ba4; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, muted ink; hover brings full ink over the 4% white veil.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5865f2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #b5bac1; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #efeff1; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); }

components.name: Auth Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with a #3f4147 border; focus moves the border to blurple with a 3px 25% ring. Labeled above in 14px/600 muted ink.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #b5bac1; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #3f4147; border-radius: 8px; color: #efeff1; font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.5; caret-color: #5865f2; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #72767d; } .ds-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #949ba4; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5865f2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.25); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat elevated panel: #2b2d31 fill, 1px #252527 hairline, 8px radius, 16px padding.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #2b2d31; border: 1px solid #252527; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; color: #efeff1; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Portaled dialog: black/70 overlay, 16px-radius #2b2d31 panel with hairline border; Esc and overlay click close.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-modal-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-modal { position: relative; z-index: 50; width: 100%; max-width: 28rem; background: #2b2d31; border: 1px solid #252527; border-radius: 16px; color: #efeff1; } .ds-modal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; } .ds-modal-head h2 { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .ds-modal-head button { border: none; background: transparent; color: #b5bac1; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.375rem; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-head button:hover { background: #35373c; color: #efeff1; } .ds-modal-body { padding: 0 1rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #b5bac1; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Floating menu: 8px radius, #2b2d31, hairline border, shadow-md; items hover #40424b; danger items are error text over a 10% error fill.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 180px; padding: 0.25rem 0; background: #2b2d31; border: 1px solid #252527; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; width: calc(100% - 8px); margin: 0 4px; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #efeff1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: #40424b; } .ds-menu-danger { color: #ed4245; } .ds-menu-danger:hover { background: rgba(237, 66, 69, 0.1); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Field-dark label on a floating layer: bg #1e1f22, hairline border, 8px radius, shadow-md, 12px text.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; background: #1e1f22; border: 1px solid #252527; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); color: #efeff1; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Server Tile (squircle morph + white pill)
components.description: The signature: a 48px tile that rests as a circle and morphs to a 16px squircle on hover/active; a white pill on the rail's left edge signals active (4x40px) or notification (4x8px); active fill is blurple.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: 72px; padding: 0.75rem 0; background: #1e1f22; font-family: 'gg sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-pill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translate(-4px, -50%); background: #efeff1; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; width: 4px; height: 0; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-pill-active { height: 40px; } .ds-tile { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: none; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: #35373c; color: #b5bac1; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-tile:hover { border-radius: 16px; background: #40424b; color: #efeff1; } .ds-tile-active { border-radius: 16px; background: #5865f2; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.northStar: The drawn app window, grown up.
narrative.overview:
The client is the tri-rail Discord shell the landing page only drew: a flat, friendly-yet-professional dark app where color does real jobs — one blurple for actions, green/amber/red for presence and state, and a charcoal ramp that tells you where you are. Density is app-tight, muscle-memory placement wins over novelty, and the surface stays matte: the shipped CSS contains no gradients, no backdrop-filter glass, and no glow.

Styling lives in packages/web/app/globals.css: :root tokens, the Tailwind v4 @theme mapping, @layer components primitives, and functional animations. The landing .ftl world and this world share a repository, not a stylesheet — never merge tokens across the two. app/sfu/page.tsx is a developer debug surface left with its own styling deliberately; it is not part of this system.
keyCharacteristics: A region ramp, not just greys: ground #121214, rail #1e1f22, list #2b2d31, chat #313338, raised #35373c, hover #40424b — the region tokens name places and are never interchangeable.
One action color: blurple #5865f2 (hover #4752c4, 16% muted wash, soft link tint #798df9); state trio success #23a559 / warning #f0b232 / error #ed4245.
Ink in four steps (#efeff1 / #b5bac1 / #949ba4 / #72767d); pure white appears only on blurple fills.
8px spacing grid, 8px control radius, 16px modals, pill avatars, 16px squircle server tiles with the white pill indicator.
One face, gg sans stack (Noto Sans shipped as the disclosed stand-in); hierarchy is size, weight, and case.
Motion is functional only and dies under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Tri-rail shell: 72px rail / nav list / chat with a toggleable members column; below lg the nav is a full-width slide-over drawer.

rules.name: The Cascade Rule
rules.body: The primitives .btn, .btn-primary/-secondary/-ghost, .input, and .card live in @layer components precisely so Tailwind utilities override them: the password field's pr-12 show/hide button, pl-10 prefix-icon inputs, w-full, and font-bold all win without !important. Future edits must keep these primitives in @layer components — moving them to unlayered CSS would silently break every utility-composed field and button.

rules.name: The Region Rule
rules.body: rail, list, and chat name places in the shell, not shades in a ramp. A new surface picks its region token by where it lives (rail-edge, list, chat) and steps to background-surface/background-hover for raised or active states — it never substitutes a raw grey.

rules.name: The Soft-Link Rule
rules.body: Inline prose links are soft blurple #798df9 with underline-on-hover; raw #5865f2 is reserved for things you click as an action (buttons, tiles, send).

rules.name: The White-Only-On-Blurple Rule
rules.body: #ffffff appears only as text or icons on accent fills. UI ink tops out at #efeff1; brighter text is not a way to add emphasis.

rules.name: The gg sans Disclosure
rules.body: 'gg sans' is Discord's proprietary face and cannot be shipped. The stack deliberately prefers a locally installed copy when present and ships Noto Sans via next/font as --font-gg — a free, metrically-similar stand-in. This substitution is intentional and disclosed; do not swap in another display face to fix it.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second typeface into the client. Emphasis is weight, case, and the 12px-uppercase section-header signature — not a new font.

rules.name: The Resting-Structure Rule
rules.body: Resting panels never cast shadows. Separation is a ramp step or a 1px hairline; a shadow appears only when a layer floats above the app (menus, tooltips, drag ghosts, the drawer).

rules.name: The Squircle Morph
rules.body: Server tiles rest as circles; hover and active morph them to a 16px squircle over 200ms. A white pill rides the rail's left edge and signals state only: 4x40px for the active server, 4x8px for a notification, nothing at rest.

rules.name: The Hover Ladder
rules.body: Use the 4% white veil (bg-white/[0.04]) on list grounds, the next ramp step (hover:bg-background-surface / -hover) on rail and panel surfaces, and 10% black (hover:bg-black/10) on the chat ground.

dos: Do keep .btn/.input/.card in @layer components so utilities keep overriding them — prefix-icon inputs (pr-12) depend on it.

Do use the hover ladder: the 4% white veil (bg-white/[0.04]) on list grounds, the next ramp step (hover:bg-background-surface / -hover) on rail and panel surfaces, and 10% black (hover:bg-black/10) on the chat ground.
Do gate every new animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and add its class to the kill list.
Do keep interactive targets >=44px (.btn min-height) with 2px accent focus-visible outlines at 2px offset.
Do keep inline links soft blurple #798df9 and write empty states in product voice.
Do portal the drawer scrim to document.body and keep drawer, scrim, and close control as three layers (drawer z-50, scrim z-40).
donts: Don't merge the landing .ftl tokens into globals.css or leak client tokens into landing.css — two worlds, two stylesheets; and don't restyle app/sfu/page.tsx (deliberate debug exclusion).
Don't introduce gradients, backdrop-filter glass, or glow — the world is matte by audit.
Don't put shadows on resting structure; they are for floating layers only.
Don't use raw #5865f2 for inline text links, and don't use pure white as UI ink.
Don't add ambient looping animation; loops carry live state only.
Don't rest server tiles as squircles — at-rest is a circle; the morph belongs to hover and active.

surfaces.summary: Auth world: centered 480px column on #121214, labeled inputs, one blurple action, hairline dividers, outline OAuth pair, collapsible QR section (real SVG at public/qr-login.svg).
Tri-rail shell: 72px rail, nav/members lists #2b2d31, chat #313338; squircle morph + white pill; drawer below lg; members lg-only.
Landing page — belongs to the separate .ftl world; see repo-root DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json.

review.result: 9/9 captures passing; two material fixes resolved in review (portaled drawer scrim, product-voice empty state).
openNotes: dnd drag-grips visible at rest on touch — belongs to the parallel dnd-kit rework; nonblocking.
review.scopeCaveat: Modals and shared primitives were declared in scope but unjudged by stills; their specs come from shipped code, not review.
